title: 0 Prologue (from Ruptures and Roots)
description:
Episode zero is required listening for the context of Reality 101. It's how I went from materialism and meditation to magic, angels, and the physics of souls in a material experience.

This episode was originally recorded for Ruptures and Roots, Joshua's podcast. It went so well that we decided to record the rest of my experiences and ideas on this limited series. If you would like to listen to more of Ruptures and Roots, please go here:

https://gospelsofrupture.substack.com/podcast
